title: Conduct unbecoming an officer.
bodyText: Any commissioned officer who is convicted of conduct unbecoming an officer shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
bodyHtml: [§124B-195]  Conduct unbecoming an officer.  Any commissioned officer who is convicted of conduct unbecoming an officer shall be punished as directed by a court-martial. [L 2022, c 286, pt of §2]
